policy: Primary papers, author publications and official implementation documentation only. Applications to this trading task are hypotheses unless supported by the local analytical probes.

sources.title: Focal Loss for Dense Object Detection
sources.use: Easy-example suppression, gamma/alpha interaction; original task is dense object detection, not noisy trading labels

sources.title: On Focal Loss for Class-Posterior Probability Estimation
sources.use: Classification calibration differs from strict propriety of probability estimates

sources.title: Calibrating Deep Neural Networks using Focal Loss
sources.use: Empirical calibration can improve despite lack of strict propriety; benchmark evidence does not guarantee trading calibration

sources.title: Strictly Proper Scoring Rules, Prediction, and Estimation
sources.use: Log/quadratic scores, distributional and quantile scoring; local custom-loss proof supplied separately

sources.title: Asymmetric Loss For Multi-Label Classification
sources.use: Separate treatment of positive and negative samples in sparse multi-label problems

sources.title: Generalized Cross Entropy Loss for Training Deep Neural Networks with Noisy Labels
sources.use: Noise-robust losses; corrupted-label assumptions do not follow from rough but correctly measured market outcomes

sources.title: An Empirical Evaluation of Generic Convolutional and Recurrent Networks for Sequence Modeling
sources.use: Causal/dilated convolution sequence baseline and empirical comparison with recurrent architectures on non-trading benchmarks

sources.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality
sources.use: Mamba-2 architecture and efficiency; no evidence here that it predicts crossing opportunities better

sources.title: Official state-spaces/mamba implementation
sources.use: Actual Mamba-2 implementation and runtime requirements, distinct from a generic SSM substitute

sources.title: DeepLOB: Deep Convolutional Neural Networks for Limit Order Books
sources.use: Domain-specific example combining local book convolutions and temporal LSTM; price-classification results are not this policy's equity evidence

sources.title: Gradient Surgery for Multi-Task Learning
sources.use: Gradient interference and model-agnostic projection; negative cosine alone does not prove separate models are needed

sources.title: GradNorm: Gradient Normalization for Adaptive Loss Balancing in Deep Multitask Networks
sources.use: Balance gradient magnitude and task learning rates; distinct from resolving semantic task conflict

sources.title: Modeling Task Relationships in Multi-task Learning with Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts
sources.use: Shared experts with task-specific gates as an intermediate point between full sharing and separate encoders

sources.title: Entire Space Multi-Task Model: An Effective Approach for Estimating Post-Click Conversion Rate
sources.use: Conditional task selection and full-population prediction; an analogy, not a market-target theorem

sources.title: A Scalable Discrete-Time Survival Model for Neural Networks
sources.use: Likelihood-based discrete-time survival and censoring with minibatch learning

sources.title: Rank consistent ordinal regression for neural networks with application to age estimation
sources.use: Monotone ordered thresholds; gain thresholds are ordered but arbitrary line names are not
